notes:
v4.6.116 — Silencing a bot no longer affects the other broker

🔇 Fixed: silencing (or hiding) a bot on Alpaca also silenced its twin on IBKR, because both brokers were sharing one bot list under the hood. Alpaca and IBKR now keep fully independent bot registries, so muting a bot on one broker leaves the other untouched.

Note: your cloud bots were never actually stopped by this — it was a display/registry mix-up. IBKR bots did start at the open; this just makes the per-broker views correct.

Update via the in-app banner.
